units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 30:35">Targ. Gen. XXX, 35</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 58b:12">B. Mets. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>דאזיל … ואתי ח׳</he> the red color (of the face) disappears, and the white takes its place; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="H00688"><he>חִיוְּרִין</he></cite>, <he>חִוָּרִין</he>, <he>חִיוְּרֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Zechariah 6:3">Targ. Zech. VI, 3</cite> (ed. Wil. <he>חַוָּ׳</he>); a. fr.—
Ber. 28ᵃ, v. חַצְבָּא; a. fr.—Fem. חִיוָּרָא, חִיוָּו׳, חִיוַּרְתָּא.
Targ. Y. Lev. XIII, 4 (ed. Berl. חַוְרָא); a. fr.—(As a noun) white skin, white spot &c.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 22:22">Targ. Y. Lev. XXII, 22</cite>.—
<cite ref="Gittin 68a:2">Gitt. 68ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ באוכמתא</he> a white spot on a dark skin, v. <cite ref="A00648"><he>אוּכָּם</he></cite>.
Ib. 56ᵃ חיורתא (Ar. חִיוָּרִיתָא) white flour, v. גּוּשְׁקְרָא; a. fr.—Pl. חִוְּרָן, חַוְּ׳, חִיוְורַן, חִיוָּורָתָא, חִוָּו׳.
<cite ref="Berakhot 28a:1">Ber. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>לית לך ח׳</he> thou hast no gray hair (art too young for the office); v. <cite ref="D01026"><he>דָּרָא</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 110a:1">Sabb. 110ᵃ</cite> top <he>תליסר חמרי ח׳</he> thirteen white she-asses.

<cite ref="Chullin 7b:7">Ḥull. 7ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 49a">Yoma 49ᵃ</cite> <he>דח׳</he> (<cite ref="T00716"><he>ריש</he></cite>) <he>כרעייהו</he> when their legs are white; a. fr. [<cite ref="Sanhedrin 98a:14">Snh. 98ᵃ</cite> <he>חיור גוני</he>, v. <cite ref="E00306"><he>הֲזָר</he></cite>.]—[<cite ref="Pesachim 42b:14">Pes. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>מיא דחיורי</he>, v. <cite ref="H00702"><he>חִיזְרָא</he> II</cite>.]
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 4:6">Targ. O. Ex. IV, 6</cite> (Y. ed. Amst. <he>מְהַוְּורָא</he>, h. text <he>מצרעת</he>).—
<cite ref="Gittin 68a:2">Gitt. 68ᵃ</cite> <he>טעמא דח׳</he> the taste of a leprous (white-spotted) animal.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 98b:14">Snh. 98ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ דבי רבי שמו</he> the name of the Messiah is ‘the leper of the house of Rabbi’; a. fr. [<he>חמר חיור יין</he>, v. <cite ref="H00688"><he>חִיוַּרְיַיִן</he></cite>.]
